headword: {通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}

definitions.gloss: popular literature; mass-market fiction; entertainment literature
definitions.explanation: Literature written primarily for entertainment and broad popular appeal, as opposed to serious or highbrow literary fiction. Encompasses genres like mystery, romance, adventure, and historical fiction aimed at a general readership.

examples.japanese: {通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しまれている→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧。
examples.english: Popular literature is enjoyed by a wide range of readers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{純文学|じゅんぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境界|きょうかい}→境界：12096_kyoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The boundary between literary fiction and popular literature is becoming blurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦前|せんぜん}→戦前：12852_senzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文学的|ぶんがくてき}⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}なされていた→見なす：10615_minasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再評価|さいひょうか}→再評価：28226_saihyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In prewar Japan, popular literature was regarded as having low literary value, but today it has been reevaluated.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{通俗|つうぞく}→通俗：22441_tsuuzoku⟧ (popular, common, accessible) and ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ (literature). In Japanese literary criticism, the distinction between ⟦{純文学|じゅんぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧ (pure/literary fiction) and {通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく} (popular fiction) has been significant since the Meiji era. The term carries a slight connotation of being less artistically serious, though this perception has softened over time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: popular fiction writer
- {通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧: masterpiece of popular literature
- {通俗文学|つうぞくぶんがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read popular fiction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大衆文学|たいしゅうぶんがく}→大衆文学：16512_taishuubungaku⟧: mass literature — nearly synonymous, but emphasizes the mass audience; this term became more common after the Taisho era
- ⟦{純文学|じゅんぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧: literary fiction, pure literature — the counterpart focused on artistic and aesthetic expression
- ⟦{娯楽小説|ごらくしょうせつ}→娯楽小説：26110_gorakushousetsu⟧: entertainment novel — focuses on the entertainment aspect of individual works
